scope.zh: {{stat:corpus.n|int}}份历史招聘归档，正文与规范化哈希均去重；采用非概率选样。
scope.en: {{stat:corpus.n|int}} historical advertisements, deduplicated by exact and normalized text; a non-probability sample.

frequencyNote.zh: 保留既有词表，正文经Unicode NFKC及大小写规范化后精确检索，每广告每词计一次。复合词排除另存候选，公开广告数为完整词面命中数，尚未判定全部用法是否指向劳动者。
frequencyNote.en: The existing vocabulary is retained. Body text is searched by exact substring after Unicode NFKC normalization and case folding, once per ad per term. Compound exclusions are retained separately as candidates. Published ad counts include all literal hits; their worker-directed meaning has not been fully reviewed.

sampleNote.zh: 案例是沿用的去识别释义，已做AI编辑复核，尚未经过人工确认；这些挑选的对照不能代表用法比例。
sampleNote.en: The retained examples are deidentified paraphrases, edited and reviewed by AI, without human validation. These selected contrasts do not represent a distribution of meanings.

short.zh: 把信息讲清楚，让对方知道下一步要做什么。
short.en: Explain information clearly enough for someone else to act on it.

context.zh: 调节注射参数、处理试模异常，并记录问题和试模结果。
context.en: Adjust injection parameters, handle trial faults and document results.

reading.zh: 沟通要把现场看到的异常和试过的调整说清，让下一位处理者知道从哪里接手。
reading.en: Communication connects the observed defect with the adjustments already tried, so the next person knows where to start.

question.zh: 试模异常记录由谁接收，何时需要升级？
question.en: Who receives a trial-fault report, and when is escalation needed?

context.zh: 选择供应商、谈价格、管理合同，并保证物料齐套。
context.en: Select suppliers, negotiate prices, manage contracts and secure complete material supply.

reading.zh: 采购沟通要同时处理价格、质量和到货安排，让供应商承诺能接上用料需求。
reading.en: Procurement communication brings price, quality and delivery into an agreement that fits the material requirement.

question.zh: 价格和交期发生冲突时，谁决定取舍？
question.en: Who decides when price and delivery conflict?

context.zh: 支持组织活动的策划、现场安排及人才发展政策实施。
context.en: Support organizational events, on-site arrangements and talent-policy implementation.

reading.zh: 这里的沟通围绕活动执行，把时间、地点、参与者和现场安排传达到位。
reading.en: Here, communication makes an event plan usable by the people attending and running it.

question.zh: 实习生负责通知、协调，还是也能调整活动方案？
question.en: Does the intern communicate arrangements, coordinate them, or also revise the plan?

short.zh: 用记录、数据或模型解释问题，提出有依据的判断。
short.en: Use records, data or models to explain a problem and support a judgment.

context.zh: 处理应收账款账龄、核对收入并编制报表。
context.en: Analyse receivables ageing, reconcile revenue and prepare statements.

reading.zh: 分析围绕应收账款和收入展开，要把报表中的差异对应回具体交易与核对材料。
reading.en: Analysis connects receivables and revenue figures back to the transactions and records that explain a discrepancy.

question.zh: 账龄异常需核对哪些单据，由谁确认处理？
question.en: Which documents establish an ageing exception, and who approves its treatment?

context.zh: 分析市场与产品特点，制定营销战略和推广计划。
context.en: Analyse the market and product characteristics to develop marketing plans.

reading.zh: 这里分析市场和产品特点，是为了选择推广方向，并讲清选择的依据。
reading.en: Market and product analysis supports a choice of promotional direction and an explanation for that choice.

question.zh: 市场判断最终要转成客户名单、方案还是预算建议？
question.en: Must the conclusion become a prospect list, a campaign, or a budget proposal?

context.zh: 分析机械臂性能，进行运动学、动力学建模与仿真。
context.en: Analyse robot-arm performance through kinematic and dynamic modelling and simulation.

reading.zh: 分析要把机械臂的运动表现转成模型、参数和可检查的仿真结果。
reading.en: Analysis turns robot-arm behaviour into models, parameters and simulation results that can be examined.

question.zh: 模型效果按哪些误差或性能指标验收？
question.en: Which error or performance measures determine acceptance?

short.zh: 按用途记录和整理信息，支持核对、解释或改进。
short.en: Record and organize information for checking, explanation or improvement.

context.zh: 记录墨水打印的流畅性、颜色、干燥及牢度测试结果。
context.en: Record ink-printing tests for flow, colour, drying and fastness.

reading.zh: 数据来自打印测试，需要把流畅性、颜色、干燥和牢度的结果与测试条件对应起来，便于比较。
reading.en: The data come from printing tests. Flow, colour, drying and fastness results need to be recorded alongside test conditions so they can be compared.

question.zh: 测试记录怎样支持下一轮配方验证？
question.en: How do recorded tests inform the next formulation trial?

context.zh: 统计招聘数据、复盘流程，改进招聘效率和候选人体验。
context.en: Review recruitment data to improve hiring efficiency and candidate experience.

reading.zh: 招聘数据要连回筛选、面试和入职步骤，解释效率与候选人体验出了什么问题。
reading.en: Recruitment data link back to screening, interviews and onboarding to explain problems with speed or candidate experience.

question.zh: 数据异常会触发哪个招聘环节的调整？
question.en: Which hiring stage changes when a metric deteriorates?

context.zh: 分析客诉数据、输出质量报告、建立分类，并协调技术部门改进缺陷。
context.en: Analyse complaints, produce quality reports, classify cases and coordinate product fixes.

reading.zh: 数据工作把分散的客诉归类、找出重复问题，再让技术部门看懂需要改什么。
reading.en: The work groups complaints, identifies recurring issues and gives the technical team enough detail to investigate them.

question.zh: 客诉分类怎样进入技术改进的排期？
question.en: How do complaint categories enter the engineering backlog?

short.zh: 核对各方安排，处理影响工作进展的分歧。
short.en: Check the parties’ arrangements and address disagreements that affect progress.

context.zh: 与制造单位协调，推进成本改善，并维护 BOM 工单系统。
context.en: Coordinate manufacturing cost improvements and maintain BOM work-order systems.

reading.zh: 协调要把成本改善放回制造现场，核对方案能否在现有物料和工序中实施。
reading.en: Coordination tests a cost-improvement proposal against the materials and processes used in production.

question.zh: 成本目标与生产限制冲突时由谁调整方案？
question.en: Who revises the plan when cost targets conflict with production constraints?

context.zh: 组织设施立项、设备采购、资产台账与维修保养。
context.en: Organize facility projects, purchasing, asset records and maintenance.

reading.zh: 设备协调贯穿立项、采购、登记和保养，关键是每一步的信息能交到下一步。
reading.en: Equipment coordination carries information through project setup, purchasing, asset registration and maintenance.

question.zh: 设备停机后，维修、采购和使用方如何接续？
question.en: How do maintenance, procurement and users coordinate after a breakdown?

context.zh: 开发区域市场、传达销售政策，并维护渠道。
context.en: Develop regional markets, communicate sales policies and maintain channels.

reading.zh: 协调发生在公司销售政策与区域渠道之间，需要把执行疑问与反馈整理清楚。
reading.en: Coordination links company sales policy with regional channels by clarifying implementation questions and feedback.

question.zh: 渠道无法执行统一政策时，向谁申请调整？
question.en: Who handles a channel’s request for a policy exception?

short.zh: 用指定工具准确完成常见任务，处理必要的修改。
short.en: Use the specified tools accurately for routine tasks and necessary revisions.

context.zh: 使用办公软件，并安排来访登记、等候与引导。
context.en: Use office software to register, accommodate and direct visitors.

reading.zh: 办公软件在这里服务于来访登记、等候和引导，熟练体现在信息准确、安排清楚。
reading.en: Office software supports visitor registration, waiting and directions. Proficiency means keeping the information and arrangements accurate.

question.zh: 日常主要使用哪些表格和系统，错误怎样核对？
question.en: Which forms and systems are used, and how are errors checked?

context.zh: 使用 AI 软件和视频剪辑工具，协助传播材料及社媒内容。
context.en: Use AI and video-editing tools to support communications and social content.

reading.zh: AI 与剪辑工具的熟练度，要落到传播内容的制作、修改和交付上。
reading.en: Fluency with AI and editing tools matters when it supports producing, revising and handing over communications material.

question.zh: AI 生成的材料由谁核实并审核发布？
question.en: Who verifies and clears AI-assisted material for publication?

context.zh: 剪辑资讯视频、制作 PPT，使用办公软件并了解商业合规。
context.en: Edit financial news videos and slides, use office tools and understand compliance.

reading.zh: 这里把剪辑、PPT 与商业合规放在一起，产物既要能看懂，也要能核对其表达。
reading.en: Editing, presentation work and commercial compliance meet in material that needs to be understandable and checkable.

question.zh: 内容制作与商业合规分别由谁验收？
question.en: Who accepts production quality and who clears compliance?

short.zh: 自行推进指定工作，并弄清需要协助或确认的事项。
short.en: Take assigned work forward and clarify where assistance or confirmation is needed.

context.zh: 独立检验零件，同时协助主管管理品质。
context.en: Inspect parts independently while assisting the supervisor with quality management.

reading.zh: 这里的独立指自己完成零件检验，同时协助主管管理品质；是否有处置决定权，需要另行确认。
reading.en: Here, working independently means completing the parts inspection while assisting the supervisor with quality management. Who decides what happens to defective parts still needs clarification.

question.zh: 发现不合格件时，谁可以决定隔离、返工或放行？
question.en: Who can quarantine, rework or release a nonconforming part?

context.zh: 强调独立学习和工作，但具体核算、审核、归档职责均写为协助。
context.en: Ask for independent learning and work while describing accounting, review and filing as assistance.

reading.zh: 这里强调自己安排学习和工作，具体核算、审核与归档仍以协助身份参与。
reading.en: The role emphasizes organizing your own learning and work while contributing to accounting, review and filing in a supporting capacity.

question.zh: 哪些事项可以自行完成，哪些必须交给财务人员复核？
question.en: Which tasks can the intern finish alone, and which require a finance colleague’s review?

context.zh: 根据分配的客户信息催收，处理诉讼、调解，并与多个部门沟通。
context.en: Handle assigned recovery cases, litigation and mediation while liaising with several departments.

reading.zh: 独立办案落在专业处理能力上，案件分配与跨部门配合仍然是工作的一部分。
reading.en: Independent case handling concerns professional execution within a workflow that also includes case allocation and cross-department coordination.

question.zh: 诉讼策略、和解条件与案件分配分别由谁决定？
question.en: Who decides litigation strategy, settlement terms and case allocation?

short.zh: 和相关人员共同完成任务，交清各自需要的信息与材料。
short.en: Work with others and provide the information and materials each person needs.

context.zh: 在新品导入、量产异常、工艺优化之外承担培训与跨部门协作。
context.en: Combine product introduction, production troubleshooting and process improvement with training and coordination.

reading.zh: 协作连接工艺文件、现场操作和培训，让改进后的做法能够被共同理解和执行。
reading.en: Collaboration connects process documentation, shop-floor practice and training so an improvement can be understood and used.

question.zh: 新工艺从文件转到产线，由哪些岗位共同确认？
question.en: Who jointly validates a new process before production uses it?

context.zh: 协同内部团队推进项目实施与交付，同时承担销售目标。
context.en: Coordinate internal implementation and delivery while pursuing sales targets.

reading.zh: 机器人销售需要和实施团队配合，把客户承诺转成可以推进的项目事项。
reading.en: Robotics sales works with implementation teams to turn customer commitments into specific delivery tasks.

question.zh: 承诺的交付范围无法实现时，谁重定范围和目标？
question.en: Who resets scope and targets if a delivery promise cannot be met?

context.zh: 与用人团队协作，拓展渠道并开展技术人才 mapping。
context.en: Work with hiring teams on channels and technical-talent mapping.

reading.zh: 与用人团队核对需要什么人才，再把需求用于渠道拓展和人才寻访。具体筛选标准怎样确定，还可以继续问。
reading.en: Check what talent the hiring team needs, then use that information to develop channels and source candidates. How selection criteria are agreed remains a useful question.

question.zh: 招聘标准出现分歧时，用人团队和招聘方如何定案？
question.en: How are disagreements over selection criteria resolved?

short.zh: 在时限、突发情况或多任务要求下继续处理工作。
short.en: Continue handling work under deadlines, unexpected events or competing demands.

context.zh: 控场、回应观众、协助主播并准备样品与道具。
context.en: Manage the live session, respond to viewers, assist the host and prepare props.

reading.zh: 抗压出现在控场、观众回应和物料准备旁边，指向实时互动中不断切换任务的要求。
reading.en: Pressure sits beside live-session control, audience responses and prop preparation, pointing to switching between tasks in real time.

question.zh: 直播突发状况怎样分工，谁负责接管？
question.en: How are live incidents divided up, and who takes over?

context.zh: 承接紧急补编，主动寻访技术人才并推进面试、谈薪与入职。
context.en: Handle urgent hiring, source technical candidates and progress interviews, offers and onboarding.

reading.zh: 招聘时限要靠寻访、面试、谈薪与入职多个步骤配合，推进结果受多方安排影响。
reading.en: An urgent hire depends on sourcing, interviews, offer discussions and onboarding, with progress affected by several parties' schedules.

question.zh: 面试官或候选人延期时，招聘目标由谁调整？
question.en: Who adjusts targets when interviewers or candidates delay?

role.zh: 人力数字化需求分析师

context.zh: 对接人事需求、组织评审、跟进研发，并明确写到投标加班。
context.en: Gather HR requirements, organize reviews and follow development; bid-related overtime is explicitly mentioned.

reading.zh: 这例既要求跟进需求评审和研发，也明确提到投标加班，时间安排应单独核实。
reading.en: This example combines requirements reviews and development follow-up with explicitly stated bid-related overtime, making the time arrangements a concrete question.

question.zh: 投标加班的频率、轮换和补偿怎样安排？
question.en: How frequent is bid-related overtime, and what rotation and compensation apply?

short.zh: 核对自己负责的事项，跟进差错与未完成的工作。
short.en: Check the work assigned to you and follow up errors and unfinished tasks.

context.zh: 接待顾客、整理货品、协助销售，并配合收银与盘点。
context.en: Serve customers, maintain stock and assist sales, checkout and stocktaking.

reading.zh: 接待、货品整理、收银和盘点都在职责中，责任心可以具体问到货品差异怎样核对、未结事项怎样交接。
reading.en: The duties include service, stock handling, checkout and stocktaking. Responsibility can be clarified through questions about checking stock differences and handing over unfinished work.

question.zh: 盘点差异和交接问题由谁核对处理？
question.en: Who checks stock discrepancies and handover problems?

context.zh: 校验活动文案，维护页面，并支持临时配置和测试。
context.en: Check campaign copy, maintain pages and support temporary configuration and testing.

reading.zh: 这里的责任心有具体落点：活动文案、页面和临时配置需要一致，测试问题要留下记录。
reading.en: Responsibility has a concrete object here: campaign copy, pages and temporary configurations need to agree, with test issues recorded.

question.zh: 上线前谁做最终审核，临时配置有无检查清单？
question.en: Who gives final approval, and is there a configuration checklist?

context.zh: 开发维护市场，落实区域策略并传达销售政策。
context.en: Develop channels, execute regional strategy and communicate sales policy.

reading.zh: 渠道责任围绕市场维护、策略落实和政策传达，需要持续记录执行情况与反馈。
reading.en: Channel responsibility covers market relationships, strategy execution and policy communication, with ongoing attention to progress and feedback.

question.zh: 区域策略中哪些事项可以自行调整，哪些需要确认？
question.en: Which parts of the regional strategy can this role adjust, and which require confirmation?

short.zh: 根据现场条件、任务变化或出差要求安排工作。
short.en: Arrange work around site conditions, changing tasks or travel requirements.

context.zh: 进行测量、材料验收、工序交接，并要求适应工地环境。
context.en: Measure, inspect materials and manage handovers in a construction-site environment.

reading.zh: 适应工地对应测量、验收和工序交接，重点是现场条件怎样影响这些工作。
reading.en: Adapting to the site concerns measurement, inspection and process handovers under the conditions where those tasks take place.

question.zh: 现场作业环境和必要防护具体是什么？
question.en: What are the actual site conditions and required protections?

context.zh: 响应业务需求，推进组织和人才工作，要求适应快节奏及多任务。
context.en: Respond to business needs and deliver organization and talent work at a fast pace.

reading.zh: 适应快节奏落在组织与人才工作的多项需求上，需要不断明确先做哪件事。
reading.en: Adapting to pace concerns multiple organization and talent requests, with repeated clarification of what should happen first.

question.zh: 多项紧急需求相撞时，谁决定优先级？
question.en: Who prioritizes competing urgent requests?

context.zh: 承担区域销售、回款和学术推广，要求适应频繁出差。
context.en: Handle regional sales, collections and professional promotion with frequent travel.

reading.zh: 适应在这里有明确地点维度：销售、回款和推广活动伴随频繁出差。
reading.en: Adaptation has a geographic dimension here: sales, collections and professional promotion involve frequent travel.

question.zh: 出差范围、频率和费用安排分别怎样？
question.en: What travel area, frequency and expense arrangements apply?

short.zh: 围绕指定结果安排工作，并按约定标准检查进展。
short.en: Organize work around specified results and review progress against agreed criteria.

context.zh: 提供护理服务，同时推荐健康产品并完成销售目标。
context.en: Provide care services while recommending products and meeting sales targets.

reading.zh: 这份工作同时提供护理服务和推荐产品，需要兼顾顾客的服务体验与销售结果。
reading.en: The role combines care services with product recommendations, bringing the customer experience and sales results into the same job.

question.zh: 服务质量与产品销售分别怎样考核？
question.en: How are service quality and product sales assessed separately?

context.zh: 承担片区销售、门店建设、产品运营与人员培训。
context.en: Oversee regional sales, store development, product operations and staff training.

reading.zh: 片区销售、建店和培训都在职责内，需要分别整理各店的经营进展、待办和问题。
reading.en: The role covers regional sales, store openings and training. It involves keeping track of each store's progress, outstanding tasks and problems.

question.zh: 销售目标之外，建店和培训是否也有独立评价？
question.en: Are store development and training assessed separately from sales?

context.zh: 开发设备厂商并办理客户融资业务，要求目标导向和外勤。
context.en: Develop equipment vendors and progress financing business, with target orientation and fieldwork.

reading.zh: 渠道开发的结果要接到具体客户的融资办理，工作需要衔接厂商、客户信息与业务进度。
reading.en: Channel development connects equipment vendors with specific customer financing needs, linking contact information to transaction progress.

question.zh: 融资办理中哪些进度由我负责，审批和风险判断由谁负责？
question.en: Which financing steps would I own, and who handles approval and risk assessment?

short.zh: 回应使用者的需要，完成接待、说明或问题处理。
short.en: Respond to users’ needs through reception, explanation or problem handling.

context.zh: 编写设计和技术文件，为机床制造提供技术服务。
context.en: Produce designs and technical documentation supporting machine-tool manufacturing.

reading.zh: 这里的服务是把设计与技术说明交给制造环节，使现场能据此理解结构、处理技术问题。
reading.en: Here, service means supplying designs and technical explanations that manufacturing teams can use to understand the structure and address technical questions.

question.zh: 制造现场如何提出技术问题，怎样确认已解决？
question.en: How does manufacturing raise and close a technical issue?

context.zh: 培训店员的服务意识和服务水平，改善消费者进店体验。
context.en: Train store staff in service standards and improve the customer experience.

reading.zh: 副店长要把消费者体验转成店员可以学习、练习和改进的接待做法。
reading.en: The deputy manager translates the desired customer experience into reception practices that staff can learn, rehearse and improve.

question.zh: 服务标准由谁制定，店员能否提出修改？
question.en: Who sets service standards, and can staff propose changes?

context.zh: 处理海外需求、在线协助排障，收集满意度并反馈交付团队。
context.en: Handle overseas requests, assist remote troubleshooting and feed satisfaction results to delivery teams.

reading.zh: 售后支持在线协助客户排查故障，并把处理过程和满意度反馈给交付团队。问题是否解决，需要核对处理结果。
reading.en: After-sales support helps customers investigate faults remotely and passes the handling record and satisfaction feedback to the delivery team. Whether a fault is resolved needs to be checked.

title.zh: 写抗压的广告，更常同时写协调
title.en: Ads mentioning pressure tolerance more often mention coordination

interpretation.zh: 这些词面结果把抗压与合作要求放到同一份文本里，提供了逐条检查合作对象的入口；尚未检验H1中的具体对象，也未调整职业构成。
interpretation.en: The co-occurrence identifies texts in which pressure tolerance accompanies cooperation language. Identifiable collaborators under H1 have not yet been coded, and occupational composition has not been adjusted.

interpretation.en: These ads invite a closer reading: who receives the numbers, and what must be explained? Co-occurrence does not establish that communication and data concern the same task.

title.en: Ads mentioning pressure tolerance more often mention coordination

note.zh: 正文规范化后按词面检索，每广告每词计一次；尚未调整职业构成。
note.en: Normalized body text is searched literally, once per ad per term; occupational composition is not adjusted.

title.zh: 写数据的广告，也更常写沟通
title.en: Ads mentioning data also mention communication more often

note.zh: 正文规范化后按词面检索，每广告每词计一次；尚未调整职业构成。
note.en: Normalized body text is searched literally, once per ad per term; occupational composition is not adjusted.

conclusion.zh: 当前最清楚的关系出现在抗压与协调之间。它让研究从一个人的承受能力，转向广告同时写出的合作要求。Urciuoli（2008）关于技能语言的研究提示我们检查这种写法，但词面相伴还没有回答合作对象是谁、承担什么任务。数据与沟通的对照则让我们继续追问，数字需要向谁解释、用来回答什么问题。自动编码与AI复核进一步显示，泛称团队和点名具体角色会给出不同的结果；识别决定权的规则还漏掉了复核中的明确授权。因此不能用自动标记的缺失来断言劳动者无权。求职者现在可以沿着这些区别，询问能得到明确答复的工作安排。
conclusion.en: The clearest current association links pressure tolerance with coordination. It directs attention from an individual’s ability to cope to the cooperation requirements written alongside it. Urciuoli’s (2008) work motivates examining this wording, but co-occurrence does not identify the collaborators or their tasks. The data–communication comparison also prompts questions about who needs the numbers explained and which decisions they inform. Automated coding and AI review show that generic team references and named roles produce different results. The authority detector also missed explicit grants found in review; missing flags cannot establish that workers lack authority. Applicants can already use those distinctions to ask specific questions about how the work is arranged.
